# memepump — commands

<!-- generated by tools/gen-docs.mjs from upstream onchainos 4.6.3; do not edit -->
Meme / pump.fun token scanning and analysis. Required flags are in the signature; `ocl memepump <cmd> --help` prints the full upstream help.

### memepump chains
Get supported chains and protocols for Meme Pump
`ocl memepump chains`

### memepump tokens
Get Meme Pump token list (filtered)
`ocl memepump tokens --chain <CHAIN> [options]`
- `--stage <STAGE>` — Token stage: NEW, MIGRATING, or MIGRATED (default: NEW) (default NEW)
- `--wallet-address <WALLET_ADDRESS>` — Wallet address for position-specific data
- `--protocol-id-list <PROTOCOL_ID_LIST>` — Comma-separated protocol IDs to filter tokens
- `--quote-token-address-list <QUOTE_TOKEN_ADDRESS_LIST>` — Comma-separated quote token addresses
- `--min-top10-holdings-percent <MIN_TOP10_HOLDINGS_PERCENT>` — Minimum top 10 holders percentage (0-100)
- `--max-top10-holdings-percent <MAX_TOP10_HOLDINGS_PERCENT>` — Maximum top 10 holders percentage (0-100)
- `--min-dev-holdings-percent <MIN_DEV_HOLDINGS_PERCENT>` — Minimum developer holdings percentage
- `--max-dev-holdings-percent <MAX_DEV_HOLDINGS_PERCENT>` — Maximum developer holdings percentage
- `--min-insiders-percent <MIN_INSIDERS_PERCENT>` — Minimum insider wallet percentage
- `--max-insiders-percent <MAX_INSIDERS_PERCENT>` — Maximum insider wallet percentage
- `--min-bundlers-percent <MIN_BUNDLERS_PERCENT>` — Minimum bundler wallet percentage
- `--max-bundlers-percent <MAX_BUNDLERS_PERCENT>` — Maximum bundler wallet percentage
- `--min-snipers-percent <MIN_SNIPERS_PERCENT>` — Minimum sniper wallet percentage
- `--max-snipers-percent <MAX_SNIPERS_PERCENT>` — Maximum sniper wallet percentage
- `--min-fresh-wallets-percent <MIN_FRESH_WALLETS_PERCENT>` — Minimum newly-created wallet percentage
- `--max-fresh-wallets-percent <MAX_FRESH_WALLETS_PERCENT>` — Maximum newly-created wallet percentage
- `--min-suspected-phishing-wallet-percent <MIN_SUSPECTED_PHISHING_WALLET_PERCENT>` — Minimum phishing wallet percentage
- `--max-suspected-phishing-wallet-percent <MAX_SUSPECTED_PHISHING_WALLET_PERCENT>` — Maximum phishing wallet percentage
- `--min-bot-traders <MIN_BOT_TRADERS>` — Minimum bot trader wallet count
- `--max-bot-traders <MAX_BOT_TRADERS>` — Maximum bot trader wallet count
- `--min-dev-migrated <MIN_DEV_MIGRATED>` — Minimum tokens migrated by developer
- `--max-dev-migrated <MAX_DEV_MIGRATED>` — Maximum tokens migrated by developer
- `--min-market-cap <MIN_MARKET_CAP>` — Minimum market cap in USD
- `--max-market-cap <MAX_MARKET_CAP>` — Maximum market cap in USD
- `--min-volume <MIN_VOLUME>` — Minimum 24h volume in USD
- `--max-volume <MAX_VOLUME>` — Maximum 24h volume in USD
- `--min-tx-count <MIN_TX_COUNT>` — Minimum transaction count
- `--max-tx-count <MAX_TX_COUNT>` — Maximum transaction count
- `--min-bonding-percent <MIN_BONDING_PERCENT>` — Minimum bonding curve completion (0-100)
- `--max-bonding-percent <MAX_BONDING_PERCENT>` — Maximum bonding curve completion (0-100)
- `--min-holders <MIN_HOLDERS>` — Minimum unique holder count
- `--max-holders <MAX_HOLDERS>` — Maximum unique holder count
- `--min-token-age <MIN_TOKEN_AGE>` — Minimum token age in minutes
- `--max-token-age <MAX_TOKEN_AGE>` — Maximum token age in minutes
- `--min-buy-tx-count <MIN_BUY_TX_COUNT>` — Minimum buy transactions (last 1 hour)
- `--max-buy-tx-count <MAX_BUY_TX_COUNT>` — Maximum buy transactions (last 1 hour)
- `--min-sell-tx-count <MIN_SELL_TX_COUNT>` — Minimum sell transactions (last 1 hour)
- `--max-sell-tx-count <MAX_SELL_TX_COUNT>` — Maximum sell transactions (last 1 hour)
- `--min-token-symbol-length <MIN_TOKEN_SYMBOL_LENGTH>` — Minimum ticker symbol length
- `--max-token-symbol-length <MAX_TOKEN_SYMBOL_LENGTH>` — Maximum ticker symbol length
- `--has-at-least-one-social-link <HAS_AT_LEAST_ONE_SOCIAL_LINK>` — Require at least one social media link (true/false)
- `--has-x <HAS_X>` — Require X (Twitter) link (true/false)
- `--has-telegram <HAS_TELEGRAM>` — Require Telegram link (true/false)
- `--has-website <HAS_WEBSITE>` — Require website link (true/false)
- `--website-type-list <WEBSITE_TYPE_LIST>` — Website types: 0=official, 1=YouTube, 2=Twitch, etc
- `--dex-screener-paid <DEX_SCREENER_PAID>` — Filter by DexScreener promotion status (true/false)
- `--live-on-pump-fun <LIVE_ON_PUMP_FUN>` — Filter by PumpFun live stream status (true/false)
- `--dev-sell-all <DEV_SELL_ALL>` — Filter by developer liquidation status (true/false)
- `--dev-still-holding <DEV_STILL_HOLDING>` — Filter by developer holding status (true/false)
- `--community-takeover <COMMUNITY_TAKEOVER>` — Filter by community takeover status (true/false)
- `--bags-fee-claimed <BAGS_FEE_CLAIMED>` — Filter by fee claim status (true/false)
- `--min-fees-native <MIN_FEES_NATIVE>` — Minimum fees in native currency
- `--max-fees-native <MAX_FEES_NATIVE>` — Maximum fees in native currency
- `--keywords-include <KEYWORDS_INCLUDE>` — Include tokens matching keyword (case-insensitive)
- `--keywords-exclude <KEYWORDS_EXCLUDE>` — Exclude tokens matching keyword (case-insensitive)

### memepump token-details
Get Meme Pump token details
`ocl memepump token-details --address <ADDRESS> [options]`
- `--chain <CHAIN>` — Chain (e.g. solana, bsc)
- `--wallet <WALLET>` — User wallet address (for position and P&L data)

### memepump token-dev-info
Get Meme Pump token developer info
`ocl memepump token-dev-info --address <ADDRESS> [options]`
- `--chain <CHAIN>` — Chain (e.g. solana, bsc)

### memepump similar-tokens
Get similar tokens for a Meme Pump token
`ocl memepump similar-tokens --address <ADDRESS> [options]`
- `--chain <CHAIN>` — Chain (e.g. solana, bsc)

### memepump token-bundle-info
Get Meme Pump token bundle (bundler/sniper) info
`ocl memepump token-bundle-info --address <ADDRESS> [options]`
- `--chain <CHAIN>` — Chain (e.g. solana, bsc)

### memepump aped-wallet
Get Meme Pump aped (co-invested) wallet data
`ocl memepump aped-wallet --address <ADDRESS> [options]`
- `--chain <CHAIN>` — Chain (e.g. solana, bsc)
- `--wallet <WALLET>` — User wallet address (to highlight if present in aped wallets)
